title: 第二十六章 余烬
content_zh:
寅时三刻，陈默准时醒来。

    无需依靠星光或更漏，这具在三年严苛作息和一月生死边缘反复拉扯过的身体，早已将时辰刻进了骨髓深处。黑暗中，他睁开眼，听着通铺里此起彼伏、或粗重或压抑的鼾声，闻着那混合了汗臭、霉味、劣质油脂和某种说不清道不明的、仿佛绝望沉淀后气息的浑浊空气，静静躺了三息。

    然后，他掀开那床冰凉的、散发着霉味的薄被，坐起身。动作很慢，带着重伤初愈、又长途跋涉后的僵硬和滞涩。左胸伤处和膻中穴同时传来熟悉的隐痛，左臂的冰凉酸麻感也清晰依旧。他深吸一口气，压下这些身体自发的“抗议”，摸索着穿上那身同样沾着尘土和药渍的粗布短褂。

    他没有点灯，在黑暗中走到墙角水缸边，用葫芦瓢舀起半瓢昨夜剩下的、冰凉的井水。水汽带着寒意扑面而来。他褪去上衣，用一块同样粗糙的旧布，蘸着冷水，从脸、脖颈、到前胸后背，用力擦拭。冷水激在皮肤上，带来一阵细微的战栗，却也迅速驱散了最后残存的睡意和因被窝带来的、虚假的暖意。伤口沾到冷水，刺痛感更清晰了些，但他恍若未觉，只是专注地、一下一下，将皮肤擦得微微发红。

    擦完身，他重新穿好衣服，走到通铺外。天色仍是浓黑，只有东方天际，有一线几乎难以察觉的、极淡的灰白。晨风凛冽，带着深秋将尽的寒意，穿透单薄的衣衫，让他忍不住打了个寒噤。他走到惯常站桩的屋檐下，那个角落似乎还残留着他往日留下的、微不足道的痕迹。

    他脱下草鞋，赤脚站在冰冷坚硬、还有些潮湿的地面上。摆开《基础淬体术》的起手式，双腿自然分开，微曲，重心下沉，双手虚抱。然而，甫一站定，他便感觉到了与往日的不同。

    身体各处传来清晰而复杂的反馈。左胸旧伤处，筋骨的拉伸带来钝痛和某种不自然的“紧束”感，仿佛那新生的疤痕在束缚着皮肉的自由舒展。膻中穴那“缝隙”处，气息随着身体的沉静而微微流转，却带来一种空洞的隐痛，以及一种奇异的、仿佛有微弱气流在“缝隙”边缘钻入钻出的、细微的“风”感。左臂的冰凉酸麻，在静立中尤为明显，气血运行似乎在那条手臂的许多细小经脉处都遇到了无形的滞涩。全身肌肉筋骨，都透着一种大病初愈后的、深入骨髓的虚弱和“不协调”，仿佛这具身体不再是一个浑然天成的整体，而是被勉强拼凑、粘连起来的破碎部件。

    更重要的是，体内那缕水木灵气，在脱离了石室山林那种相对“干净”、灵气稍浓的环境，回到这污浊晦暗的杂役院后，变得异常“懒惰”和“稀薄”。他尝试运转苏芸所授的呼吸法，试图引动、梳理它，却发现它运行得极为滞涩艰难，对四肢末端劳宫、涌泉穴的感应也变得模糊不清，几乎无法有效从外界汲取到任何有益的、可称为“灵气”的东西。只有呼吸本身，带来些许微弱的、与周围污浊环境的共鸣，让他勉强维持着心神的沉静，不至于被身体的种种不适完全淹没。

    这感觉，就像一条习惯了清澈溪流的小鱼，被突然扔回了一潭浑浊不堪、几乎无法呼吸的死水。

    但他没有动摇，也没有焦躁。只是静静站着，调整着呼吸，用全部心神去感知、去适应、去“安抚”身体各处传来的种种不适与新奇的“感觉”。他将意念放得极轻，不再强求运行周天或引动灵气，只是让那套呼吸法的韵律，在身体内部缓缓流淌，如同最温柔的抚摸，试图让这具“破车”的各个部件，重新找到彼此磨合、协同工作的那个“点”。

    一炷香的时间，在寒冷、隐痛、滞涩和对身体“陌生”的感知中，缓慢流过。当远处传来第一声鸡鸣，天边那线灰白稍稍扩散时，陈默缓缓收势。双腿因久站和寒意而微微发麻，额角却渗出了一层细密的冷汗——不是累的，而是心神高度集中、与身体种种不适“对抗”与“调和”的结果。

    他穿上草鞋，活动了一下有些僵硬的四肢，然后拿起靠在墙角的柴刀和绳索。柴刀的刀柄上，缠裹的布条依旧是苏芸在石室中为他换上的、干净的白色棉布，只是此刻也沾上了尘土。他握了握刀柄，入手冰凉，却有一种奇异的、令人心安的实在感。

    他转身，向后山走去。脚步不快，甚至比受伤前更慢，每一步都带着小心，尽量减轻对左胸和膻中穴的震动。但每一步，都踩得很稳。

    后山的晨景，与石室附近截然不同。少了那份幽深静谧，多了人为砍伐的痕迹和杂役们早起劳作的声响。空气中弥漫着柴火、泥土、晨露和远处灶房飘来的、劣质油脂燃烧的气味。

    陈默选了一片林木相对稀疏的坡地。挥起柴刀，砍向一棵碗口粗的枯树。

    “笃！”

    柴刀砍入木头，传来的反震力道让陈默手臂微微一麻，左胸伤处也随之传来牵扯的痛楚。他眉头微蹙，调整了一下握刀姿势和发力方式。不再是以前那种凭借年轻气力、略显莽撞的猛砍，而是尝试着将挥刀的动作，与呼吸，与体内那缕微弱气息的流转，隐隐结合起来。

    吸气，举刀，意念微沉，气息稍凝于臂。呼气，挥落，刀锋顺着木头的纹理切入，同时意念引导气息随刀势“流”出，并非增加力量，而是让动作更“顺”，更“稳”，减少不必要的反震和身体损耗。

    很细微的调整，几乎无法带来力量上的实质增加，甚至因为要分心控制气息和动作配合，初时反而显得更慢、更别扭。但他坚持着，如同练习一套新的、生疏的拳法。一刀，又一刀。

    汗水很快浸湿了他的后背，额头也冒出汗珠。左臂的酸麻感在持续挥砍中变得更为明显，但似乎也因气血的加速运行，那冰凉的麻木感稍有缓解。膻中穴的隐痛，在气息随动作流转时，时而加剧，时而因“通畅”感传来而略微舒缓，复杂难言。

    他砍得很专注，不再追求速度，而是专注于每一次挥砍的“质量”——角度是否最佳，发力是否顺畅，气息配合是否和谐，对身体的负担是否最小。他仿佛不是在砍柴，而是在用这最原始枯燥的劳动，重新“校准”这具刚刚经历剧变、伤痕累累的身躯，重新建立身体、意念、气息与手中工具、与眼前劳作之间的联系。

    日头渐高，林间光影斑驳。其他砍柴的杂役早已背着柴捆下山，陈默才堪堪砍够三捆。他将柴禾仔细捆扎好，试了试分量，比受伤前轻了些，但捆扎得更扎实。然后，他背起柴捆，一步步向山下走去。

    沉重的柴压在肩头，左胸伤处和右肩旧伤同时传来清晰的压迫痛楚，呼吸也变得短促。他不得不更频繁地停下，调整呼吸，运转那套呼吸法，平复气血的翻涌和伤处的痛感。下山的路上，他遇到了几个相熟的杂役，对方看到他，大多只是点点头，或投来一个夹杂着同情、漠然或些许好奇的复杂眼神，便匆匆走过，没人多问，也没人停留。
content_en:
At three o'clock in the morning, Chen Mo woke up on time.
There is no need to rely on starlight or leaks. This body, which has been repeatedly pulled on the edge of life and death in three years of rigorous work and rest and one month, has already carved time into the depths of the bone marrow.In the darkness, he opened his eyes and listened to the heavy or suppressed snores coming and going in the bunk. He smelled the turbid air that was mixed with the smell of sweat, musty, bad grease and some inexplicable smell, like the breath of despair. He lay quietly for three breaths.
Then, he opened the cold, musty-smelling thin quilt of the bed and sat up.The movements were very slow, with the stiffness and sluggishness of recovering from a serious injury and traveling a long distance.The familiar dull pain came from the left chest injury and Tanzhong point at the same time, and the cold, sore and numb feeling in the left arm was still clear.He took a deep breath, suppressed the spontaneous "protests" of his body, and fumbled to put on the coarse cloth jacket that was also stained with dust and medicine.
Without lighting a lamp, he walked to the water tank in the corner in the dark and used a gourd to scoop up half a ladle of the cold well water left over from last night.The water vapor hit my face with a chill.He took off his shirt, dipped an old piece of rough cloth in cold water, and wiped his face, neck, chest and back vigorously.The cold water hit the skin, causing a slight shiver, but it quickly dispelled the last remaining drowsiness and the false warmth brought by the quilt.The cold water on the wound made the stinging sensation clearer, but he didn't seem to notice it. He just focused on rubbing the skin until it turned slightly red.
After wiping himself, he put on his clothes again and walked outside the main shop.The sky was still dark, with only an almost imperceptible line of very faint gray on the eastern horizon.The morning wind was brisk, carrying the chill of late autumn, which penetrated his thin clothes and made him shiver.He walked to the eaves where he usually stood, and there seemed to be insignificant traces of his past in that corner.
He took off his straw sandals and stood barefoot on the cold, hard, yet damp ground.Open the starting position of "Basic Body Tempering Technique", spread your legs naturally, bend them slightly, lower your center of gravity, and hold your hands empty.However, as soon as he stood still, he felt something different from the past.
Clear and complex feedback comes from everywhere in the body.In the old injury on the left chest, the stretching of the muscles and bones brought dull pain and some unnatural "tightening" feeling, as if the new scar was restricting the free expansion of the flesh.In the "gap" of Tanzhong point, the breath flows slightly as the body becomes calm, but it brings a hollow dull pain, and a strange, subtle "wind" feeling, as if there is a weak airflow drilling in and out of the edge of the "gap".The cold, soreness and numbness in the left arm was especially obvious when standing still. The flow of Qi and blood seemed to encounter invisible stagnation in the many small meridians of that arm.The muscles and bones all over the body showed a kind of weakness and "incoordination" that penetrated into the bone marrow after recovering from a serious illness, as if this body was no longer a natural whole, but broken parts that were reluctantly pieced together and glued together.
More importantly, the water and wood spiritual energy in the body became extremely "lazy" and "thin" after leaving the relatively "clean" and slightly dense environment of the Shishi Mountain Forest and returning to this dirty and dark courtyard.He tried to operate the breathing method taught by Su Yun, trying to induce and sort it out, but found that it was extremely sluggish and difficult to operate, and the induction of the Laogong and Yongquan points at the ends of his limbs also became blurred, making it almost impossible to effectively absorb anything beneficial that could be called "spiritual energy" from the outside world.Only the breathing itself brought some weak resonance with the dirty environment around him, allowing him to barely maintain a calm mind and not be completely overwhelmed by the various discomforts in his body.
It felt like a small fish accustomed to a clear stream was suddenly thrown back into a pool of stagnant water that was so turbid that it was almost impossible to breathe.
But he didn't waver or get anxious.Just stand quietly, adjust your breathing, and use all your heart to perceive, adapt, and "soothe" all kinds of discomfort and novel "feelings" coming from everywhere in your body.He relaxed his thoughts very lightly, no longer forcing the movement of the heavens or inducing spiritual energy. He just let the rhythm of the breathing method flow slowly inside the body, like the gentlest caress, trying to make the various parts of this "broken car" find the "point" where they fit together and work together.
The time of a stick of incense flows slowly through the cold, dull pain, stagnation, and the "strange" perception of the body.When the first rooster crow came from the distance and the gray line on the horizon spread slightly, Chen Mo slowly stopped his momentum.My legs were slightly numb from standing for a long time and the cold, but a thin layer of cold sweat broke out on my forehead - not from fatigue, but the result of being highly concentrated and "fighting" and "reconciling" with various physical discomforts.
He put on his straw sandals, stretched his somewhat stiff limbs, and then picked up the hatchet and rope leaning against the wall.The cloth wrapped around the handle of the hatchet was still the clean white cotton cloth that Su Yun had put on for him in the stone chamber, but it was also stained with dust at this moment.He held the handle of the knife. It was cold, but he felt a strange and reassuring sense of reality.
He turned around and walked toward the back hill.The pace is not fast, even slower than before the injury. Every step is taken with care, trying to reduce the shock to the left chest and Tanzhong point.But every step was taken firmly.
The morning view in the back mountain is completely different from that near the stone chamber.The deep silence is missing, and there are more traces of man-made felling and the sound of handymen getting up early to work.The air was filled with the smell of firewood, soil, morning dew and the burning smell of low-quality grease from the distant stove.
Chen Mo chose a slope with relatively sparse trees.He swung his hatchet and chopped down a dead tree as thick as a bowl.
"Tuk!"
The hatchet cut into the wood, and the force of the shock caused Chen Mo's arm to feel numb, and the wound on his left chest also felt pain.He frowned slightly and adjusted the posture of holding the knife and the way of exerting force.It is no longer the slightly reckless slashing that relies on youthful strength, but it is trying to vaguely combine the action of swinging the knife with breathing and the flow of the weak breath in the body.
Inhale, raise the knife, your mind sinks slightly, and your breath condenses on your arm.Exhale, swing down, and cut the blade along the grain of the wood. At the same time, your mind guides the breath to "flow" out with the force of the knife. This is not to increase strength, but to make the movement more "smooth" and "steady" and reduce unnecessary shock and body wear.
Very small adjustments can hardly bring about a substantial increase in strength, and even make it seem slower and more awkward at first because you have to concentrate on controlling your breath and coordinating your movements.But he persisted, as if practicing a new and unfamiliar boxing technique.One knife, another knife.
Sweat quickly soaked his back, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.The soreness and numbness in his left arm became more obvious as he continued to slash, but it seemed that the cold numbness was slightly relieved due to the accelerated flow of Qi and blood.The dull pain in Tanzhong acupoint is sometimes intensified when the breath flows with the movement, and sometimes it is slightly relieved due to the "smooth" feeling. It is complicated and difficult to describe.
He was very focused on slashing, no longer pursuing speed, but focusing on the "quality" of each slash - whether the angle was optimal, whether the force was exerted smoothly, whether the breath coordination was harmonious, and whether the burden on the body was minimal.It seems that he is not chopping wood, but using this most primitive and boring labor to re-calibrate this scarred body that has just undergone drastic changes, and to re-establish the connection between body, mind, breath, tools in hand, and the work in front of him.
The sun is getting higher, and the light and shadow in the forest are mottled.The other handymen who cut firewood had already carried bundles of firewood down the mountain, and Chen Mo had only managed to chop three bundles.He carefully bundled the firewood and tested the weight. It was lighter than before the injury, but the bundle was stronger.Then he picked up the bundle of firewood and walked down the mountain step by step.
Heavy firewood was pressing on my shoulders, and there was clear pressure and pain from the injury on the left chest and the old injury on the right shoulder at the same time, and my breathing became short.He had to stop more frequently, adjust his breathing, and use the breathing method to calm the surge of blood and blood and the pain of the injury.On the way down the mountain, he met several familiar handymen. When they saw him, most of them just nodded, or cast a complicated look that was mixed with sympathy, indifference or a little curiosity, and then hurried past, no one asked more questions, and no one stopped.
